verdict.rationale: CockroachDB offers `cockroach demo` for spinning up temporary, in-memory clusters and single-node clusters explicitly for testing/dev use, plus Cockroach Continuum which supports virtual clusters for developers and agents to deploy separately from a dedicated host cluster — all clearly separable from production data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation framing this as an AI-agent 'sandbox' workflow, isolation/security guarantees between virtual clusters and production, and independent confirmation of these features in practice.
